reasons: Datadog nginx.net.request_per_s measures requests per second, but the candidate uses nginx.connections_accepted, which counts connections (unit {connections}). That is a different quantity, so the translation is wrong.
No OTel metric in the provided definitions measures requests, so the correct outcome is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, not translated.
The template variable $scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct. The sum aggregation with no grouping matches the Datadog query shape.
